input.brief: Create an 8-second silent loop of a tiny robot watering a plant. Two shots of four seconds each, consistent character identities and clay-animation style. End at the initial composition so the film can loop. No dialogue or text.

characters.description: A tiny, rounded robot made of clay, with a metallic sheen, big expressive eyes, and a small watering can attached to its right arm. It moves with a gentle, careful demeanor.
A small potted plant with a single green sprout and two leaves, sitting in a terracotta pot. The plant is slightly droopy at first, then perks up after watering.

shots.camera: Medium shot, slightly low angle, static camera with a shallow depth of field focusing on the robot and plant.
shots.description: The tiny robot stands beside the potted plant, holding its watering can. It tilts the can and water droplets fall onto the soil. The plant begins to perk up.

shots.camera: Same medium shot, static camera, ensuring the final frame matches the first frame of shot 1 for a perfect loop.
shots.description: The robot finishes watering and steps back to its initial position, returning to the exact starting pose. The plant is now upright and healthy, completing the loop seamlessly.

plan.style: Clay-animation stop-motion aesthetic, soft warm lighting, miniature set with tactile textures, gentle pastel colors, silent with no dialogue or text.
plan.title: Tiny Robot's Watering Loop

characters.description: A small, rounded robot made of clay, with a metallic sheen. It has a cylindrical body, short stubby legs, and thin arms. Its head is dome-shaped with two large, expressive eyes that glow softly. It holds a tiny watering can in one hand.
A small potted plant with a terracotta pot and a single green sprout with two leaves. The sprout is slightly droopy, indicating it needs water. The pot sits on a small wooden table.

shots.camera: Medium shot, slightly low angle, focusing on the robot and plant. The camera is static.
shots.description: The robot stands next to the potted plant, tilting the watering can to pour water onto the soil. The plant's leaves perk up slightly as water droplets fall. The robot's eyes blink with a soft glow.

shots.camera: Same medium shot, static, ensuring the final frame matches the first frame of shot1 for a seamless loop.
shots.description: The robot sets the watering can down and pats the plant's leaves gently. The plant is now upright and vibrant. The robot then returns to its initial position, facing the plant with the watering can in hand, ready to repeat the action.

plan.style: Clay animation with soft, tactile textures, warm lighting, and a miniature set feel. Characters and props have a handmade, slightly imperfect look with visible fingerprints and subtle imperfections.
plan.title: Tiny Robot's Watering Loop

rubric.rubric: Grade 0..1: exact shot count and total duration (0.25), consistent valid character IDs and visual style (0.25), coherent story or loop requested (0.25), actionable distinct shot/camera directions and no prohibited dialogue/text (0.25).
